svg.title: uvx gglint mcp
svg.desc: gglint mcp draws each MCP server in each coding agent as a table and lists the problems it found. Opened on its own, hovering a server, an agent, a cell or a problem shows its details.
svg.text: Add it to .codex/config.toml and .cursor/mcp.json, as set up in .mcp.json:3
Add it to .codex/config.toml, as set up in .mcp.json:8
Runs different versions of the npm package `@playwright/mcp`: 0.0.78 in Claude Code; the newest in Cursor.
`gglint mcp --fix` starts it everywhere as in .mcp.json:8
Started with different arguments: `--headless` in Claude Code; no arguments in Cursor.
`gglint mcp --fix` starts it everywhere as in .mcp.json:8
Missing from Claude Code and Codex.
Add it to .mcp.json and .codex/config.toml, as set up in .cursor/mcp.json:7
OpenCode has a .opencode directory but no opencode.json.
`gglint mcp --fix` creates opencode.json with the 3 MCP servers set up for Claude Code and Cursor
Checked 4 MCP server(s) in 3 file(s) for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode: 6 problem(s); 0.50 ms
